note:
<dgnPriority:1>
<dgnInfo:
(World Orb) A World Orb for the 1st
world, the world of Acrydia.
>
<dgnInfo2:
    World Orbs
are special magic items that
unlock portals inside of a Shrine of
Worlds.  Shrines of Worlds allow
travelers access to and from other
worlds, and contain these portals that
one may walk, swim, crawl, or fly through
to reach such other places.  Because
Shrines of Worlds normally have
consistent and uniform air pressure,
temperature, lighting, and other possible
conditions inside the shrines, portals
located inside these shrines don't often
have any drafts or anything that spills
out of one world and into another when a
portal is unlocked.  World orbs will
temporarily unlock a portal so that both
living creatures and inanimate objects
etc. can pass to and from the interior of
another shrine.  While a portal is
locked, a magical force field prevents
such travel.  To unlock a portal, one
needs the World Orb for the destination
world on the other side of the portal.
If one wishes to later return back to the
world they came from, they also need the
World Orb for the side of the portal they
started out on.  When unlocked, the
portal isn't much more than a magical
doorway allowing travel.
\LB
    Outer doors that allow one entry to a
Shrine of Worlds are typically heavy
storm doors made of metal or stone, and
in some cases can even be almost an
airlock to a world the shrine is located
inside of, as weather and time of day
varies tremendously outside of a shrine.
Shrines of Worlds, are located in various
places in worlds that do not have to have
their time of day, weather patterns, or
how long a day lasts to be in sync with
each other, or have any consistency.
\LB
    World Orbs
are not unique items.  Their
rarity varies from world to world.  In
some worlds, one can find a merchant that
sells one, for a price that can be little
or great, with no consistency.  In some
worlds, certain World Orbs are common,
perhaps with travelling merchant caravans
that do business in more than one world,
while other World Orbs could be hard to
find.  Accross the worlds, some World
Orbs are treasured and rare, while others
are common and easy to come by, and as
such aren't worth much if they have any
market value.  These things vary
tremendously from world to world, as well
as lacking consistency in the same world
with World Orbs of different colors.
\LB
    World Orbs
vary in color and sometimes
even color patterns, and all worlds that
contain a Shrine of Worlds have a
specific color or color pattern for
World Orbs that unlock portals going to
only that world in any Shrine of Worlds.
>

Worlds.  Shrines of Worlds allow
travelers access to and from other
worlds, and contain these portals that
one may walk, swim, crawl, or fly through
to reach such other places.  Because

consistent and uniform air pressure,
temperature, lighting, and other possible
conditions inside the shrines, portals
located inside these shrines don't often
have any drafts or anything that spills
out of one world and into another when a
portal is unlocked.  World orbs will
temporarily unlock a portal so that both
living creatures and inanimate objects
etc. can pass to and from the interior of
another shrine.  While a portal is
locked, a magical force field prevents
such travel.  To unlock a portal, one

name: Magic Flower
note:
<dgnLevel:1>
<dgnFoodPrice:5000>
<dgnMaxCount:100>
<dgnPriority:6>
<dgnGroup>
<dgnInfo:
(Magic Item) A Magic Flower will
bestow a magical enchantment upon one
individual, which lasts for a limited
amount of time.  The flower is consumed
in the process.  The enchantment offers
enhancements to ability scores and
partial protection from
ability-score-lowering debuffs.
>
<dgnInfo2:
    Magic flowers have distant ancestry
that goes back thousands of years to
planet Earth, and very far back are
relatives of flowering plant species
native to Earth, which were brought to
Acrydia and nine other worlds by the
ancient natives of the ten worlds that
brought in life from Earth and
terraformed their ten worlds into being
like that of Earth, although with the
imported Earth-origin life being gifted
with magic that became natural to the
spirit of all such life, resulting in
plants, animals, and people from Earth
having magical gifts that would vary from
individual to individual.\LB
    Magic flowers are of course an
example of such enchanted life, a
non-sentient plant species that has a
highly magical nature that is tied to
the spirit of the plant.  Such flowers
grow in the wilderness as well as magic
gardens of people of the ten magical
worlds, and are edible plants that can
be safely eaten raw for nutrition and
magical benefits, as well as being used
as an ingredient in both foods and
magic potions, oils, bread, and other
magical and herbal products that include
various foods and medicines.\LB
    Once they are picked from the plant
that bears them, magic flowers will last
a suprisingly long time before they
start to go bad and decay if they are not
consumed.  On the other hand, there isn't
any reliable method of preserving them to
make them last longer, although the
flowers themselves can be preservatives
for other perishable foods and products,
which is why breads and pastries baked
with magic flowers as an ingredient last
a rather long time before going stale.
>
